subject: Physical and Health Education
sourceFile: Copy of Basic Science & Tech BECE Syllabus - syllabusNG.txt
examFormat: The BECE Basic Science and Technology syllabus aims to help candidates gain a fundamental understanding of science and technology, apply scientific and technological knowledge to address modern societal needs, and be equipped with essential knowledge for further studies in science and technology. Basic Science and Technology is examined in four compulsory papers (I–IV). Physical and Health Education is examined in Paper I, which has 60 multiple-choice questions covering Basic Science together with Physical and Health Education, with an allocated time of sixty minutes.
excluded: Syllabus.ng marketing ("About us", "About BECE"), eligibility, registration, grading table, table of contents and the FAQ chapter were left out. The Basic Science, Basic Technology and Computer Studies themes of the same file are in their own subject files.
